methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Emelody is a Growth-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jon Thomas and Elizabeth Johnson that has raised $10M+. The valuation assessment draws from a sector universe of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), including notable private companies such as Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

Given data constraints, only the Stage-Progression method is applicable. This approach uses total capital raised ($10M) as a proxy base value and applies a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical for Growth-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $12M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably executed due to insufficient narrow-filter comparables within Robotics & Manufacturing at matching stage and tier—while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the threshold of 3+ datapoints after filtering for stage and valuation proximity. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects the single applicable method and the absence of robust peer-derived anchors. Key uncertainties include the lack of recent transaction data for near-peer robotics companies at similar scale, limited granularity on Emelody's revenue or unit economics relative to the peer set, and reliance on the total-raised proxy as a valuation anchor. Additional financial metrics and comparable transactions would materially strengthen conviction in any point estimate within this range.
